[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=56] In this paper, we seek to better leverage gloss knowledge in a supervised neural WSD system. We propose a new solution to WSD by constructing context-gloss pairs and then converting WSD to a sentence-pair classification task. We fine-tune the pre-trained BERT model and achieve new state-of-the-art results on WSD task.
